# HexPiece 2.6.6

Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **The blade flickering in first person when you turn Haki on: a likely fix.** Turning Haki on plays the original's Haki
  animation, which shows your body's arms in first person. The sword was then drawn twice: once in that arm, once in the
  first-person view. In first person the sword is now drawn once, except during cuts.
- If the lag stays after this, it is probably your skin being blackened (slow on phone graphics). Please say whether the lag also
  happens with Haki on and an empty hand.
